name: scan-time-preflight-code-correction
body: `solution.component.scan-time-preflight` is implemented-by `rust.apg.frontends.scan_time_preflight`, which resolves the language's scan-time tools on PATH and fails with an actionable error naming the missing tool, and `rust.apg.frontends.spawn_frontend`, which assembles the frontend command and calls `Command::spawn`.
